title: Initial velocity magnitude
description: Essential: The student's answer must state the block's initial speed as 4 m/s.

title: Time on plank
description: Essential: The student's answer must state the time the block slides on the plank as 1/3 s.

title: Platform height
description: Essential: The student's answer must state the platform height as 5/9 m.

title: Momentum conservation setup
description: Important: The solution must apply momentum conservation for the block-plank system, relating initial and final velocities.

title: Energy/work-friction relation
description: Important: The solution must relate the work done by friction to the change in kinetic energy of the system.

title: Block kinematics on plank
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply kinematics (v^2 - u^2 = 2as) to the block's motion relative to the plank.

title: Plank motion after separation
description: Optional: The solution may explicitly calculate the time for the plank's center to reach point O after the block leaves.

title: Sign error in friction work
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the work done by friction is assigned an incorrect sign in the energy equation.

title: Relative displacement mistake
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the total distance the block slides on the plank is incorrectly taken as less than 7l/6.
